description: This Java source file defines utility methods for converting between internal data structures and protocol buffer representations related to calculated fields, including serialization/deserialization, handling different argument types, and managing alarm and geofencing states.

classes.name: CalculatedFieldUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for converting calculated field data structures to and from protocol buffer representations, handling various argument types, alarm states, and geofencing data.

methods.name: toProto
methods.description: Converts a CalculatedFieldId to its protocol buffer representation.

methods.name: toProto
methods.description: Converts a CalculatedFieldEntityCtxId to its protocol buffer representation.

methods.name: fromProto
methods.description: Reconstructs a CalculatedFieldEntityCtxId from its protocol buffer representation.

methods.name: toProto
methods.description: Converts a CalculatedFieldState to its protocol buffer representation, including handling different argument types and alarm states.

methods.name: toSingleValueArgumentProto
methods.description: Serializes a SingleValueArgumentEntry into its protocol buffer form.

methods.name: toArgumentIntervalProto
methods.description: Serializes an AggIntervalEntry and its status into an ArgumentIntervalProto.

methods.name: toRollingArgumentProto
methods.description: Serializes a TsRollingArgumentEntry into its protocol buffer form.

methods.name: toGeofencingArgumentProto
methods.description: Serializes a GeofencingArgumentEntry into its protocol buffer form.

methods.name: toGeofencingZoneProto
methods.description: Serializes a GeofencingZoneState into its protocol buffer form.

methods.name: fromProto
methods.description: Reconstructs a CalculatedFieldState from its protocol buffer representation.

methods.name: fromSingleValueArgumentProto
methods.description: Deserializes a SingleValueArgumentProto into a SingleValueArgumentEntry.

methods.name: fromRollingArgumentProto
methods.description: Deserializes a TsRollingArgumentProto into a TsRollingArgumentEntry.

methods.name: fromGeofencingArgumentProto
methods.description: Deserializes a GeofencingArgumentProto into a GeofencingArgumentEntry.
